exposure: History of therapeutic D&C associated with pregnancy
cohort: The study included 685 singleton pregnancies scanned between 16-24 weeks' gestation.
finding: A positive history of D&C is associated with a significantly increased risk of intrauterine adhesion-membrane complex (AMC), while a previous history of CS is not.
mod_finding: A previous history of Cesarean section (CS) is not associated with a significantly increased risk of intrauterine adhesion-membrane complex (AMC).
